architectural-decision-records.why: records the layout-agnostic test-resolution decision and why no shared helper
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0057: copied gate tests locate their gate at the upstream OR consumer path (inlined, not a shared import, because tests travel one file at a time)
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the fix ships a discriminating test proving the copied tests detect in a consumer
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added an esk-genesis test that genesis the real repo into a consumer and runs the copied gate tests with node --test there; before the fix they failed (upstream path absent in a consumer)
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change fixes test logic across four gate tests, so the level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: made each gate test self-contained and layout-agnostic, and added a consumer-run integration check; the right level for tests that travel into consumers
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the changed tests; the behavior is pinned as a scenario
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements the layout-agnostic gate resolution with a consumer-green scenario that goes red on the old upstream-only path
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the resolution limit rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that resolution is by filename at two fixed locations and a non-standard gate location would not be found, which is out of scope since the generator fixes the layout
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran a fresh-context judge-arch over the four test edits, the consumer-green test, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: test path resolution; no input, auth, data, file-handling, or dependency surface

release-deployment-safety.why: a test fix; nothing deployed, migrated, or released

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, data, or resilience architecture change

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or migration

arch-encode.why: a bug fix, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
